### 2026-10-11 – Completed the basic firmware for the desk buddy, included 4 different pages, a pomodoro helper with 25 and 5 minute timers, blinking animations, also included a normal clock with the timers, also can

**2h**

Completed the basic firmware for the desk buddy, included 4 different pages, a pomodoro helper with 25 and 5 minute timers, blinking animations, also included a normal clock with the timers, also can read its current battery voltage to tell me to charge whenever require! Was incredibly tiring because one of my first ambitious firmware projects with constant finding out what can do what using google and AI help but I am happy where  i am now....
